native_algorithm.augmentation: unmodified two random overlapping context crops and binomial timestamp masking
native_algorithm.averaging: unmodified AveragedModel initialized once and updated after every optimizer step
native_algorithm.encoder_selection: final SWA after exactly2880 updates; no VAL forecast or reconstruction checkpoint selection

training_data.source: same standardized past-imputed context512 values, restricted to canonical origins whose full history window lies inside TRAIN bounds
training_data.preferred_pool: all canonical TRAIN origins satisfying origin-context>=train_start and origin<=train_end
training_data.oversized_pool_action: stop before fit if all eligible windows exceed2GiB; do not silently change pool
training_data.sampling: official DataLoader shuffle=True/drop_last=True; not MLP's with-replacement per-epoch stream
training_data.missing_input: finite prior-imputed inputs; original observed masks remain in D8 fitting and scoring
training_data.provenance: record original canonical count/hash, eligible count/hash, excluded count/hash, min/max history and TRAIN bounds, window count/hash/bytes before fitting
training_data.difference_from_mlp: MLP may read known pre-TRAIN history while its reconstruction targets are TRAIN-masked; native contrastive training excludes such history windows entirely
training_data.instance_definition: overlapping past512 windows are separate native contrastive instances; differs from single-series split forecasting recipe

export.output: FP32[B,512,K], returned to caller input device
export.receptive_field_basis: depth3 produces4 residual blocks with two kernel3 convolutions at dilations1/2/4/8; calculated from native source
export.cost_included: native rolling windows, CPU/GPU transfers and duplication/_net+SWA model residency

decoder.reuse: K sweep's exact FORECAST_RIDGE_D8 and common initial/final lambda grids, TRAIN-only RMS, masks, origins and validation selection

comparison_scope: same K/VAL/frozen F/final decoder rules/update upper bound; TRAIN-only fit but different full-history window pool, objective/optimizer/capacity/receptive field/data order and actual compute
